The '''void forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] and was home to [[slybex]]es. It was so dark that [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] were not able to see their own [[Limb/Legends|hands]] in front of their face.<ref name="Scars" /> In [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}} [[Nira (Crystal guard)|Nira]] stated that her story happened five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, so the events must have happened in [[3624 BBY]].</ref> [[crystal guard]]s were transporting [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] through the forest when they got attacked by an alpha slybex. The entire unit, save for [[Nira (Crystal guard)|Nira]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the creature. Because of that, the forest was soon closed off to the crystal guard.<ref name="Scars" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The void forest was first mentioned in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
